update.releaseNotes:
v1.7.2 - Grand Concert plays on phones, and the app fits phone screens
- New: Grand Concert plays on screens 1080 pixels wide and taller than 1920, finale and spark reroll included. Tested on one 1080x2316 phone only. - Fixed: the Grand Concert tutorial's "Are you sure?" question is answered instead of reopening its menu. - Fixed: pages, the menu and the Home log no longer hide behind the navigation bar, the keyboard no longer covers the log search, and cut-off titles, buttons and dialog text show in full. - Changed: a goal that needs a G1 race, or a race of G3 or Pre-OP grade or higher, enters only races that count for it, and near its deadline also enters a single-star one. Not seen in a live career yet. - Changed: the TP restore and spark reroll switches show in Run Queue Settings without a run queue.
